# EziTranslate

> EziTranslate (also known as Live Translator) is a real-time speech translation product for meetings and videos. It ships as a Chromium browser extension and a Windows desktop app.

Website: https://translate.ezitech.io/
Publisher: Ezitech
Contact: https://translate.ezitech.io/#faq

## What it does

- Live speech-to-text and translation overlays for meetings and videos
- Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, YouTube, WhatsApp Web, and many other sites (extension)
- Windows app translates system audio from any application on the PC
- 60+ languages
- Optional voice narration (TTS), transcript / SRT export, webpage translation, screen recording
- Session sharing (Pro+): share a live translation session via link or QR; viewers follow original + translated text in real time
- In-app feedback from Settings (extension)
- Actions Library of curated AI fast actions
- Pro / Pro+ plans: no daily translation/AI caps — monthly quota only (Free keeps daily limits)

## Editions

| Edition | Best for | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser extension | Meetings and media inside the browser; fullest feature set | Chrome Web Store |
| Windows app | Audio from any desktop app (Zoom/Teams desktop, players, games) | https://translate.ezitech.io/desktop/LiveTranslator-Setup-latest.exe |

One account / license covers both editions.

## Pricing (USD)

- Free: $0 — included daily/monthly quotas
- Pro: $4.99/month or $49/year
- Pro+: $13.99/month or $139/year — higher quotas + session sharing

## Privacy

Conversation audio is processed for recognition/translation; the product emphasizes private local client handling and does not store meeting video/conversation content on EziTranslate servers for the core overlay flow. See the privacy policy for details.
